name: invoicepdfs/invoicepdfs
description: InvoicePDFs turns a JSON document into a polished PDF — invoices, credit notes, quotes, receipts, proformas, purchase orders and delivery notes. The API validates your data, computes totals correctly (tax, discounts, shipping), and returns a downloadable, professional PDF.  This package is the official client for the InvoicePDFs API, generated from the OpenAPI specification.  Documentation: https://invoicepdfs.com
